title: feat: PATCH /api/v1/lesson-plans/{id} — AI edit via LP Assistant proxy
feat: PATCH /api/v1/lesson-plans/{id} — AI edit via LP Assistant proxy
resolution: PATCH endpoint implemented. Proxies to LP Assistant /api/edit-lp. Saves content_before + content_bilingual_before to lesson_plan_edits table before overwriting. 4 new tests, all passing.

title: feat: POST /api/v1/lesson-plans/review — standalone LP reviewer endpoint
feat: POST /api/v1/lesson-plans/review — standalone LP reviewer endpoint
resolution: Endpoint implemented. New POST /api/v1/lesson-plans/review accepts lesson_plan_id or lesson_plan_html + subject + grade. Calls LP Assistant /api/review-lp. Stores result on LP record when id provided. Subject mapped Eng->English. DB migration adds review JSONB NULL to lesson_plans. GET /{id} response includes review field.

title: improve: POST /api/v1/lesson-plans/review — grade/subject optional when lesson_plan_id provided
improve: POST /api/v1/lesson-plans/review — grade/subject optional when lesson_plan_id provided
resolution: Made grade/subject optional in LessonPlanReviewRequest. Added model_validator that enforces both fields when lesson_plan_html is provided. In the lesson_plan_id path, grade and subject are now read from the fetched DB record (lp.grade/lp.subject) instead of the request.
